Features.title: Everything trust & safety teams need to scale safely
Features.description: A unified control plane for moderation, policy, compliance, and LLM safety — designed for platforms operating across NA, EU, and global markets.

multimodal.title: Multimodal Content Moderation
multimodal.description: Real-time text, image, audio, and video classification with calibrated risk scores and explainable policy signals.

policy.title: Dynamic Policy Builder
policy.description: Compose automation rules without redeploying models. Ship policy changes in minutes with versioning and rollbacks.

compliance.title: Global Compliance & Data Sovereignty
compliance.description: Stay ready for GDPR, EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, and KOSA with region-aware processing and audit-ready evidence.

hitl.title: Human-in-the-Loop Orchestration
hitl.description: Route edge cases to specialist reviewers with SLA timers, escalation trees, and quality sampling built in.

llm.title: LLM & Model Safety Evaluations
llm.description: Red-team prompts, jailbreaks, and tool misuse continuously. Benchmark model safety before and after releases.

identity.title: Identity-Aware Trust Signals
identity.description: Correlate abuse patterns across accounts, devices, and sessions to stop coordinated harm at the source.

Playground.title: Test content safety live — no account required
Playground.description: Run preset attack scenarios or paste your own content. See pass/block decisions, risk breakdown, latency, and matched policies in milliseconds.
